details:
VRChat should make more ranks so when users want to play more they can show off how long they been playing the game, the first rank would be first time, to rank up, they would need an hour to rank up to newbie then visitor. when you hit trusted user like normal, well there would be more like, friend rank or very known user. for jokes VRChat should add "unc rank" every April 1st. to show love to the other creators for avatars or worlds, there would be an two rank system for them, it would be the same for how long they been doing avatars or avatars. I'm looking at the ranks,

there's 

visitor, new user, user, known user, trusted user and two other, nuisance rank which I've never heard of and VRChat team (thanks Gemini).

the new ranks that users may want is

-First time (white)

the first time will show you don't know the game or the full controllers, the highest hours you would get is 1-5 hours to rank up, no friends really.

-Newbie (White) 

Newbie will show you have been playing the game for less then a week and getting used to the controls.

-visitor

starting to get used to be around other users and so on.

-New User

new user is where you start unlocking things

-User (Lime Green)

user is will show that you have friends and know some of the controllers 

the know and trusted will be the same.

-Known User (Orange): Experienced rank; allows users to toggle their nameplate display to look like a standard "User".

-Trusted User (Purple): The highest standard rank, showing extensive playtime and positive community interaction

then the higher rank.

-friends (Dark purple)

friends rank will show you been playing the game for awhile now and have many friends, you may also get the option to kick or ban that user from that world depending on your reporting history and other things, you would have to request this by vrchat, they would do an background check while they ask questions.

 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-VIP (you choose the color) 

shows your support by vrc+. it will be next to your real rank, like trusted next to it will be VIP

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

now lets say you wanna have the BEST rank. 

-Trail moderator, 

kinda like friends but its higher rank for moderating

-Close Rank.

the close rank is you gone through a lot of memories, played VRChat a lot, also hade VRChat plus and blocked, lost people you missed or gone through things in the vrchat world.

-veteran user/elite/elder (color of your choice and name of your choice)

veterans with maybe 8 years of playing the game will get this, show you been through some things and lost some friends and other things. this will also be the last rank, showing you are the most known user. 

you would unlock a lot of things but this is the hardest rank to get. like you need more then 10,00 hours, or played for 10-5 years (the game has been out for 12 years by the way) 

now the funny jokes,

-unc rank (means your an uncle and say "back in my day") 

-stinky mod (all you do is moderate and don't take showers)

-noob

those are optional, April 1st >:)
title: Ranks
